content:
The [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Body mass index and healthy weight range. Enter your weight and height and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like. It is one of the [Health & Fitness tools](/tools?category=Health%20%26%20Fitness) on CalcHub — the others work the same way.

Body Mass Index compares weight to height and is used worldwide as a quick screening tool for weight-related health risk in adults. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Health & Fitness tools include [Calorie Calculator](/calorie-calculator), [BMR Calculator](/bmr-calculator) and [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator). People also look for this tool as "body mass index calculator", "bmi chart", "healthy weight calculator".

## How to use the BMI Calculator

Start by entering your weight (kg), then entering your height (cm). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your weight (kg).
2. Enter your height (cm).
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)². Categories: under 18.5 underweight, 18.5–24.9 healthy, 25–29.9 overweight, 30+ obese.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. 70 kg at 1.75 m gives 70 ÷ 3.0625 = 22.9 — a healthy BMI. Try the same figures in the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Weight: 70 kg, Height: 175 cm), the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) returns Your BMI: 22.9, Category: Healthy weight, Healthy weight range: 56.7 – 76.3 kg. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Calorie Calculator](/calorie-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- BMI doesn't distinguish muscle from fat.
- Waist circumference adds useful context.
- Children use BMI-for-age percentiles instead.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a healthy BMI?

For most adults, 18.5 to 24.9. Try it with your own numbers in the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Is BMI accurate for athletes?

Not always — muscular people can score as overweight while having low body fat. For figures that matter, such as money, health or legal deadlines, check the result against an authoritative source before acting on it.

### What formula does the BMI Calculator use?

BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)². Categories: under 18.5 underweight, 18.5–24.9 healthy, 25–29.9 overweight, 30+ obese. You can see it in action in the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the BMI Calculator?

Just Weight and Height. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.

Yes. The BMI Calculator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) and start straight away.
